facts.text: The Cove sits steps from Cove Beach and Paradise Beach; both beaches are reserved for Atlantis guests.
facts.excerpt: sits steps from Cove Beach and Paradise Beach (accessible only to guests of Atlantis)

facts.text: Of all the Atlantis hotels, The Cove is the closest to the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Of all of Atlantis’s hotels, The Cove is the closest to the ocean

facts.text: Every suite at The Cove has ocean views, a private balcony and separate living and sleeping areas.
facts.excerpt: Each luxurious suite at our hotel at Atlantis offers sweeping ocean views, a private balcony, elevated in-room amenities, and separate living and sleeping areas.

facts.text: Suites are decorated in light woods and maritime colors of sand, coral and azure, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Inside you’ll find a tasteful palette of light woods and maritime colors––sand, coral, azure––that nicely complement the drama seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: Suites have walk-in closets and bathrooms with soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: The walk-in closets and generous bathrooms with soaking tubs are amenities you’ll appreciate

facts.text: The Cove Pool is an area reserved for adults, with multi-level pools, beachside cabanas with butler service and outdoor gaming.
facts.excerpt: of The Cove Pool, an adults-only area with four multi-level pools, 20 private beachside cabanas with butler service, and outdoor gaming.

facts.text: The private cabanas at The Cove Pool and Beach are exclusively for guests of The Cove.
facts.excerpt: Experience the peak of beachfront luxury in your private cabana at The Cove Pool & Beach, exclusively for guests of The Cove.

facts.text: Each Bahamian-inspired cabana was designed with the touch of interior designer Lulu De Kwiatkowski.
facts.excerpt: Each Bahamian-inspired cabana features the touch of interior designer Lulu De Kwiatkowski.

facts.text: Lapis at The Cove is a concierge-level club on the 22nd floor for guests 12 and older staying in Lapis Club Ocean, Azure or Sapphire suites.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the 22nd floor, Lapis at The Cove is a concierge-level club exclusively for guests 12 and older staying in a Lapis Club Ocean Suite, Azure Suite, or Sapphire Suite at The Cove.

facts.text: The Lapis club's dedicated concierge can make dinner reservations and arrange golf, spa and private cabana bookings.
facts.excerpt: A dedicated concierge can assist with all your needs, from making dinner reservations to arranging golf, spa, and private cabana bookings.

facts.text: The Cove's long open-air atrium has koi ponds and East Asian design flourishes.
facts.excerpt: The koi ponds and the East Asian design flourishes throughout the long, stately, open-air atrium contribute to the tranquil vibe

facts.text: The all-suite Cove opened in 2007.
facts.excerpt: The all-suite Cove opened in 2007 (the same year as its neighbor, The Reef)

facts.text: The Cove received a comprehensive renovation in 2017.
facts.excerpt: It received a comprehensive renovation in 2017.

facts.text: Cove guests have full access to the attractions and amenities of Atlantis, including the 141-acre Aquaventure water park.
facts.excerpt: Take advantage of full access to all the attractions and amenities of Atlantis, including dining from three Michelin-starred chefs, the 141-acre Aquaventure water park, and award-winning golf and spa offerings.

facts.text: The Cove is very close to the family-friendly Cascades Pool and Aquaventure Water Park and has become an increasingly popular family option.
facts.excerpt: but it is also very close, not only to the beaches, but to the family-friendly Cascades Pool and the Aquaventure Water Park, and has become an increasingly popular family option.

facts.text: José Andrés's Fish restaurant is situated at The Cove itself.
facts.excerpt: one of the very best is situated at The Cove itself: José Andres’s Fish.

facts.text: Sea Glass, in the heart of The Cove, serves light tapas, fruit-infused martinis and signature cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of The Cove, enjoy light tapas, fruit-infused martinis and signature cocktails.

facts.text: Mandara Spa at Atlantis combines Balinese healing touches, European therapies and natural indigenous elements, with warm and cold plunge pools, steam and sauna rooms.
facts.excerpt: Mandara Spa at Atlantis brings together ancient Balinese healing touches, traditional European therapies and natural indigenous elements. Our Paradise Island spa resort offers warm and cold plunge pools, as well as steam and sauna rooms.

facts.text: Because The Cove is closest to the ocean, walking times to some parts of the resort can be slightly longer.
facts.excerpt: but it also means walking times can be slightly longer to certain parts of the resorts.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: The Lapis Club Lounge on the 22nd floor was revamped in 2022 and offers dining with a sea view and a full bar.
facts.excerpt: In 2022, the hotel revamped its club offering into the exclusive Lapis Club Lounge on the 22nd Floor, which offers dining with a view of the sea; a full bar;

facts.text: The Cove is a deluxe hideaway between two private beaches.
facts.excerpt: Discover the sophisticated side of The Bahamas at The Cove, a deluxe hideaway nestled between two private beaches.
